name: The Deepwrought Scholarate
_setNote: Introduced in Thunder's Edge — available whenever rules/gameMode.ts's own hasThundersEdge(gameMode) is true.

startingTechnologyChoice.note: Not a straight "choose 2 from a list" — during setup, this faction actually RESEARCHES a technology twice (i.e. RR 90's own full research action, prerequisites and all, resolved twice), rather than just picking 2 techs off a fixed menu the way most factions' own starting-technology mechanic works.

factionAbilities.name: RESEARCH TEAM
factionAbilities.effect: When ground forces are committed, if your units on the planet are not already coexisting, you may choose for your units to coexist.
factionAbilities.note: "Coexist"/"coexisting" is the same shared game concept this project already models for the Titans of Ul's own COALESCENCE ability (see data/factions/titans_of_ul.json) — not a new, Deepwrought-only mechanic.
factionAbilities.faq: Confirmed (Dane's ruling, SCPT episode 443): Deepwrought may use Research Team to avoid combat even if the committing opponent WANTS combat to happen, as long as Deepwrought's own units on that planet weren't already coexisting beforehand.

factionAbilities.name: OCEANBOUND
factionAbilities.effect: When your units begin coexisting on a planet, gain an ocean card and ready it. Any time you have more ocean cards than there are planets that have your coexisting units, discard ocean cards until you do not.

versions.effect: Place this card faceup in your play area and gain 1 non-faction, non-unit-upgrade technology that the Deepwrought player owns; place that technology on this card. Return that technology to the deck and this card to the Deepwrought player at the end of the status phase.

factionSpecificComponents.description: A card equivalent to a planet card, each with resource and influence values of 1/1 — gained/discarded per the OCEANBOUND faction ability, always kept in step with how many planets currently have this player's coexisting units.

factionTechnologies.name: Radical Advancement
factionTechnologies.effect: At the start of the status phase, you may replace one of your non-unit-upgrade technologies with a technology of the same color that has exactly 1 more prerequisite.

factionTechnologies.name: Hydrothermal Mining
factionTechnologies.effect: At the start of the status phase, gain 1 trade good for each ocean card in play.

breakthrough.name: Visionaria Select
breakthrough.effect: ACTION: Exhaust this card to allow each other player to spend 3 trade goods and give you 1 promissory note. Each player that does may research a non-faction, non-unit-upgrade technology. You also gain each technology researched this way.

abilities.name: Tidal Passage
abilities.effect: This ship can move through systems that contain your units, even if other players' units are present; if it would, apply +1 to its move value for each of those systems.

abilities.name: Tidal Withdrawal
abilities.effect: When another player activates this system, if this unit is coexisting, you may move it and any of your infantry on its planet to a planet you control in your home system.

agent.name: Doctor Carrina
agent.ability: When another player researches a technology: You may exhaust this card to allow that player to ignore 1 prerequisite; if they do, you may place 1 infantry from your reinforcements into coexistence on a non-home planet they control.
agent.faq: Cannot trigger coexistence on a planet that has no ground forces on it at all — there must already be units present on the target planet for this to place Deepwrought's infantry into coexistence there.

commander.name: Aello
commander.unlock: Have an ocean card in play.
commander.ability: When another player spends resources to research a technology: That player may reduce the cost by 1; if they do, gain 1 commodity or convert 1 of your commodities to a trade good.
faq: NOT optional for the Deepwrought player to withhold once unlocked — any player may use it whether or not the Deepwrought player wants them to.

If Deepwrought has an alliance partner (i.e. via Alliance promissory note), other players CAN benefit from Aello twice in the same instance — once per each player whose commander ability applies; with Mahact in the mix as well, this can reach 3 separate uses, since each player using the ability resolves their own separate instance of it.

hero.name: Ta Zern
hero.effect: ACTION: Purge this card and a non-unit-upgrade technology you own or from your deck; then, purge all cards with the same name owned by other players and in other players' decks. Then, each player that purged a technology they owned researches another technology.
